answer.description: The full answer in Markdown. This is the substance — do not summarise it away into key_points.

key_points.description: The load-bearing claims, one per item, each standing on its own. Empty array if there are none.

confidence.description: How much the answer should be trusted as stated.

caveats.description: Conditions under which the answer stops holding, or what you did not check. Empty array if none.
